items.title: Bensouda says NPP’s dominance in URR is exaggerated
items.summary: By Tabora Bojang As the political fever boils towards the presidential election in December, Unite party leader and KM Mayor Talib Bensounda is hopeful of ending the ruling NPP’s dominance in the Upper River Region. Speaking to The Standard about a recent tour of the region wh...
